For customer referral programs, see referrals. For launch-specific partnerships, see launch.

content.user_title: Plan Co-Marketing Partnerships and Joint Campaigns
content.value_statement: Selecting suitable partners and coordinating joint campaigns requires clear priorities and shared expectations. This skill structures partner evaluation, campaign ideas, outreach, responsibilities, and measurement.
actual_capabilities: Evaluate potential partners across audience fit, audience size, brand alignment, engagement quality, reciprocity, and execution ease.
Suggest joint content, events, integration promotions, and community campaigns based on shared audiences and assets.
Draft partner outreach emails with a specific campaign proposal and meeting request.
Outline campaign agreements covering responsibilities, timelines, lead handling, branding, costs, and metrics.
Define quantitative and qualitative measures for campaign reviews and future collaboration.
Compare integration, reseller, affiliate, co-marketing, and marketplace partnership strategies.
limitations: Provides planning guidance and drafts, not automatic outreach, campaign execution, or partner recruitment.
Does not include runnable integrations or independently verified account-overlap data.
Does not verify cited business statistics, current partner availability, or projected campaign results.
Does not establish lawful lead-sharing consent, brand permissions, or legally enforceable agreements.

use_cases.title: Identify Complementary Partners
use_cases.description: Compare adjacent tools serving the same buyers and prioritize partners using audience fit, reciprocity, and execution readiness.

use_cases.title: Develop a Joint Webinar Plan
use_cases.description: Turn a shared customer problem into a webinar concept with promotion commitments, owners, deadlines, and success measures.

use_cases.title: Prepare Partner Outreach and Agreements
use_cases.description: Draft a specific outreach proposal and define responsibilities, brand approvals, lead handling, and campaign review expectations.

prompt_templates.title: Find Partner Categories
prompt_templates.prompt: We sell [product] to [audience]. Suggest five complementary partner categories and explain the shared audience and workflow fit. Ask for missing context.

prompt_templates.title: Brainstorm Joint Campaigns
prompt_templates.prompt: Our company and [partner] serve [audience]. Suggest five joint campaigns using [assets], within [budget] and [timeline]. Compare effort, mutual value, and success measures.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: develop campaign options with a known partner.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Partner Proposal
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft outreach to [partner] proposing [campaign]. Use [audience overlap evidence] and [our contribution]. Include one concrete idea, a meeting request, and call preparation.

prompt_templates.title: Prioritize and Structure a Campaign
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [five partner profiles] using all six scoring criteria. Recommend one for [goal]. Outline responsibilities, deadlines, promotion, consent-based lead handling, brand approvals, costs, and measurement.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: select a partner and prepare an execution plan.

output_examples.input: We make project management software for design agencies. Which partner categories should we evaluate?
output: Design tools: shared agency buyers and complementary creation workflows.
Proposal tools: project intake connects naturally to delivery planning.
Invoicing tools: billing follows the same client project lifecycle.
Score candidates from one to five across audience fit, size, brand alignment, engagement, reciprocity, and execution ease.
Validate fit using customer surveys and authorized account-overlap information.

output_examples.input: Plan a joint webinar between our marketing analytics product and a content management platform.
output: Topic: connect content publishing decisions with measurable campaign performance.
Analytics team: prepare measurement examples and present the reporting segment.
Content platform team: prepare publishing examples and manage event logistics.
Promotion: agree on email commitments, social posts, deadlines, and brand approvals.
Lead handling: confirm registration consent and permitted follow-up before sharing contact information.
Review: compare registrations, qualified leads, engagement, and attributed revenue.

output_examples.input: Draft outreach proposing a campaign between ClearMetrics and PublishFlow for B2B marketing teams.
output_examples.output:
Subject: ClearMetrics + PublishFlow webinar idea

Hello [Name],

I lead partnerships at ClearMetrics, a marketing analytics tool.

Both companies serve B2B marketing teams working on content performance.

Could we co-host a webinar connecting content publishing with campaign measurement?

We can prepare reporting examples and promote the event to our audience.

Are you available for a short call to discuss contributions and timing?

[Your name]

best_practices: Provide your audience, product positioning, assets, budget, and timeline before requesting partner recommendations.
Validate audience overlap and reciprocity with current evidence before committing to a campaign.
Document responsibilities, promotion commitments, consent-based lead handling, brand approvals, and success measures before launch.
anti_patterns: Choose partners only for audience size while ignoring fit, engagement, and mutual value.
Treat generated recommendations or historical business statistics as verified research.
Share customer lists or imply brand endorsement without appropriate authorization.

faq.question: What does this skill help me produce?
faq.answer: It helps draft partner evaluations, campaign ideas, outreach emails, agreement outlines, and campaign measurement plans.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide your product, target buyers, audience metrics, existing partners, available assets, budget, timeline, and campaign goal.

faq.question: Does it contact partners or execute campaigns?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and drafts. You must approve outreach and manage campaign execution.

faq.question: Are Crossbeam, Introw, and PartnerStack integrations included?
faq.answer: The skill links to external integration guides. The reviewed package does not include runnable connectors or configured service access.

faq.question: Does it handle customer referral programs?
faq.answer: It distinguishes customer referrals from company partnerships and directs detailed referral or affiliate program mechanics to the separate referrals skill.

faq.question: Can I share all webinar leads with a partner?
faq.answer: Do not assume permission. Verify registration consent, privacy obligations, and approved follow-up before sharing leads. This skill does not provide legal clearance.
